identity: ONE original armoured sentinel, the Meridian Lockguard veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the ivory plate armour with gold trim, the navy cloth split tabard, the closed round sundial helmet of gold and ivory with a short top spike, and gold sabatons. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The near screen-LEFT arm bears ONE huge tall pointed navy and ivory sundial shield with a gold central boss; the far screen-RIGHT hand holds ONE gold-shafted polearm angled up toward screen right, topped by a round violet gem between TWO cyan-violet crystal crescent blades. Preserve the shield, the polearm, the sundial helmet and the armoured adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full polearm with both crescents, the shield, the helmet spike, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, motion trails, slash arcs, sparks, particles or extra limbs; the crystal crescents keep only their steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the polearm or shield.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady sentinel idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall under the plate, he resettles the tall shield on his arm and tilts the polearm a little so the crescents dip and rise, the helmeted head turns slightly to scan, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: March in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with heavy armoured steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The shield is carried in front and the polearm angled up; the tabard swings with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE polearm strike toward screen right. He raises the polearm high overhead with both crescents up as the knees bend, then lunges forward on the front leg and swings it down level so the crescent head reaches full extension at screen right, pulls it back and raises it to the original angled stance. One strike only; the shield stays on the near arm.

hit_h3_v1.action: He starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The helmeted head and shoulders rock back, the shield swings and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the shield and the polearm, then he rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Bring the tall sundial shield square in front of the body, bend the knees and crouch behind it with the helmet tucked down and the polearm braced at the side, then hold the covered guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying salute. He lifts the polearm straight up high with the crescent head toward the sky while the shield stays in front, holds it there briefly, then lowers it back to the original angled stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow change or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. His knees buckle and he sinks down onto his knees behind the shield, the polearm head dropping to the ground, and stays there a moment. Then he topples forward onto his side and lies down, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen left and the boots at screen right, the shield beneath his shoulder and the polearm lying on the ground in front. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
